Introduction

Kong XiaoYin, also known as Bee, is a Chinese idol singer. She is a graduated member of Chinese idol group SNH48 (Team SII), and its sub-unit 7SENSES under STAR48.

On October 14, 2020, Kong XiaoYin graduated from SNH48 (Team SII) on October 14, 2020, but announced she'd continue her activities with 7SENSES. On March 25, 2021, she announced on her official Weibo account that she would be leaving 7SENSES after rumours of a love scandal.
